reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text:
If you need to speak to someone other than AI it is the most frustrating process. I have now been charge twice for the subscription because had so much trouble even setting up the MFA and did not want to pay $15 a month to use the zero verification.

If you would like simple communication when you need assistance I would avoid using Xero.

reviews.title: The worst app I have used
reviews.text: If getting points for over complicating things was a thing this app would take top spot cancelled membership on the second day.

reviews.title: No Quote Reminders
reviews.text: Enabling Quote Reminders to follow up would increase our sales revenue. This is similar functionality to Invoice Payment reminders and should be quick and easy for Xero to implement but so far nothing…

reviews.title: Over rated
reviews.text: Downloaded this based upon all the reviews but whilst setting it up you can't even format an address properly to look professional. Attempted to log in via desktop which means downloading another ap to do so and still can't format the address on invoice template to look like it hasn't been designed by a 3 year old. Unsure if this is due to being a UK address rather than  US but any which way I will be deleting the ap and subscription's as it just doesn't work!

reviews.title: Limited functionality
reviews.text: This app does a lot less than just using the website on mobile. Unclear on its purpose.

reviews.title: No Super approval
reviews.text: The only thing I want to use the app for is quickly approving super payments and the app doesn’t support it.

reviews.title: Charges after cancellation scam
reviews.text: This app is trash

reviews.title: Great app but major bugs
reviews.text: The app is definitely helpful and mostly good to use when it comes to writing up invoices and keep track of business expenses. But the actual app it self crashes way too much freezes up while in use. I’ll be considering other accounting options if this continues.

reviews.title: This App is useless
reviews.text: Every time I had to use it, I needed to be near the computer screen to verify that it is me using it… if I need to send a quote quickly on the go, amend an invoice or something else… I can’t rely on it because I simply can’t log. The security code to enter the app has 4 digits but the digits on the authentication app has four, if I enter my own phone password, it logs me out for 5 minutes… the software itself if fiddly, expensive and not so user friendly… horrible looking invoices with very little customisation allowed. If you think you’ll make your life easier, keep looking, this app is not for you. If you think it’ll make it easier for your clients to pay for the invoice, just know that there’s an extra fee for the service plus they keep a percentage of the total amount you are getting paid.

reviews.title: BAS
reviews.text: I am finding it impossible to locate where to do my bas since the update a few months ago. I have clicked on every button available and I cannot find it, therefore I now need to turn on my laptop and do it from there instead, a 5 minute job is now stressful as my laptop is old, one of the reasons why I got XERO on the iPad, I can take it anywhere and quick to do the BAS. disappointed to say the least

reviews.title: From bad to worse
reviews.text: App was working fine for a year on my ipad pro, after an update a few months ago when they added a useless numeric keyboard for the quantity and price section, it doesn’t let me send invoices! Keyboard shows up and disappears straight away, have to use the iphone to complete a basic invoice and send it! Tech support doesn’t even have a number to call, the app doesn’t work properly and they keep milking me £44.40 a month! Time to look for a replacement as the developers seem to be asleep and sending out updates without properly testing them.

reviews.title: Greedy price increases every year
reviews.text: Their product is ok, not as good as QBO. Their price used to be the selling point. but now after raising prices every year, and doubled over 3 years, they no longer have any selling point. Planning to move over to QBO, And I’m telling all my friends on social media to do the same.

reviews.title: Xero log in
reviews.text: Disgusting account system. Need to send and invoice urgently, and xero does the let me log in. Contact Support, and the don’t respond. Is a joke

reviews.title: Printing invoices
reviews.text: very frustrating trying to print a paper record of an invoice received

reviews.title: “Trust this device” button doesn’t work
reviews.text:
When signing in on my MacBook computer, I tick the box “trust this device” yet it doesn’t actually work. 

Every time you have to do the 2FA again and it hasn’t trusted your device like it should. 

Please fix asap as it’s super annoying

reviews.title: Poor experience/don’t recommend
reviews.text: I have found navigating your app confusing. I signed up for a free trial and tried to cancel when I realised I couldn’t use it. I couldn’t find a way to cancel and it slipped my mind (I have disabilities too and I’m doing the best I can with poor executive functioning). When I got charged at the end of the free trial I again couldn’t find a way to cancel. When I typed in my issue. No response matched mine. I was frustrated and upset not knowing how to cancel. Somehow I found some way to email… I explained my issue and I was told in black and white terms the rule your end ie no refund, 30 days cancellation notice required, etc, and no openness to my situation. I’m on a pension and make pocket money on Etsy. $70+ is a lot of money for me to loose on nothing. I emailed back and no response. Very poor customer service and money grabbing company. This situation arose because it was not transparent how to find a way to cancel when I realised this app was no working for me.

reviews.title: Far too expensive
reviews.text: Slow at creating invoices and adding payments, Not worth the money and the annual increase in pricing is a kick in the guts. Never again!

reviews.title: Waste of 30 minutes
reviews.text:
I have Xero on my desk top but putting it on the iPhone is a complete waste of time. I logged in it said my bank accounts were overdrawn they are not it said I have not sent any invoices I have. I tried to link bank accounts and it just went round in circles log on to bank ok log into Xero enter set up key what set up key 
Given up

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: Been using Xero for a few years now has been good but recently opted to use the card payment service (Stripe) which I feel I have been scammed, as a small business I require prompt payment but this service has strung payments out for a week plus and charge a fee 🤬 not happy at all will be looking to change to a different accounting app as a result

reviews.title: Must buy a plan to continue..
reviews.text: Not actually free and please remove all the excessive ads from Amazon prime it’s exhausting and painful it feels like CIA torture tactics

reviews.title: Useless App
reviews.text: Can we please have it work with full functionality so that we can use our ipads or mobile phones and check chart of accounts and reports. Its useless app.

reviews.title: Missing basic functionality
reviews.text:
Astounding that in 2024 Xero still insist that if you’re travelling you must take your laptop and not your iPad, or use the cumbersome browser (if that’s even possible). How is such a basic function as running payroll not possible within the app?

Edit: Still not possible two years later. I’ve now moved elsewhere as I really need this most basic of functions.

reviews.title: Worst software
reviews.text: Coming from quickbooks thinking it would be similar. I mean the app crashes constantly, stripe partner is terrible for payments, nothing but headaches since day 1. DO NOT recommend

reviews.title: Doesn’t Open - dreadful update
reviews.text: Been with Xero for 7 years and have 5 businesses on the Xero app.  Since the last update the app won’t even open.  If it ain’t broke don’t fix it.  My FD now looking at shifting our 5 accounts to another provider where the app works.   Silly silly update Xero

reviews.title: Can’t create invoices any more
reviews.text: App updated, now when I click the + to create things, when I select from the options it just goes back to the dashboard. Please fix.

reviews.title: GST illegal
reviews.text: Annoying app that, incredibly, and illegally, quotes retail prices without GST.  That’s ok for wholesale transactions, but not for retail.   It’s frustrating and annoying.  No one wants the GST separated.  Do your job properly and give us a program that enhances our business instead of creating friction with our customers.

reviews.title: New version of app is terrible
reviews.text: Old app was good to use and functional. New app is badly formatted and crashes often.

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text: Tried to connect my bank and all it does is keep asking for code when I get code I have to re sign in and get yet another code just repeats continuously

reviews.title: Laggy
reviews.text: The most laggy app I have on my phone. Multiple times I’ll go to write an invoice and it’ll glitch out and self close the app forcing me to restart the invoice not to mention the response time to click anything is ridiculous

reviews.title: Not intuitive
reviews.text: I created an online account on zero on my tablet, not using the app. when I’ve tried to log into the app on my phone it’s trying to get subscribe again, although I already have a subscription. It’s very inconvenient. Will be using different software.

reviews.title: No Acess
reviews.text: The app isn’t User friendly. Fort Knox would be a better name for this app.

reviews.title: Update means doesn’t update!
reviews.text: Last weeks update has stopped bank fees on the app. Despite going back in on laptop and re linking it still doesn’t work. Useless

reviews.title: Too many limits
reviews.text: Not being able to manage subscription for services is annoying. Credit card subscriptions for multiple services is the norm these days, why no recurring auto reconciled option for this. Also splitting income and outgoings by a percentage based on a category. These are two major headaches

reviews.title: Not Working
reviews.text: Trying to let you know the app hasn’t been working on iPhone for 4 days. It doesn’t open. Will delete this review when you realise it’s broken and update.

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text:
Can’t log in - keeps saying the same message over and over again…
Logs you into the web app (which is useless on a phone) but doesn’t let you use the app itself. What a piece of junk. Worked fine on android btw.

reviews.title: No way to access my account
reviews.text: I have a xero account through my company and when I log in to the app it shows me a paywall forcing me to chose a plan to gain access with no work around. I don’t need a plan, my company pays for a plan, I can access my account fine on the desktop and on mobile chrome so why not the app? No helpful info in the FAQs on the website. Ridiculous.

reviews.title: Very very average and glitchy
reviews.text:
The system doesn’t want work more than it does.
And then as a platform it’s just very average tech spa very sensitive process (your accounts).
I would avoid.

reviews.title: Not mobile friendly
reviews.text: I don’t find the Xero app mobile friendly at all. You can’t edit invoices once sent, can’t adjust details. Half the things you can see online you can’t see on your phone. I understand it’s a business app but it’s just very boring and hard to navigate. Just so many things I dislike about the app - so much could be done to make it better.

reviews.title: Not mobile friendly
reviews.text: This app is total trash and looks like it was designed to run on Windows 95 or something. How is it possible when we can literally do nearly anything on our bones, they can’t even include a search function or permit you to view your chart of accounts? Not to mention we can’t run a payroll cycle from the app.

reviews.title: Discounts only for new customers
reviews.text: It works but ends up Expensive.  Discounts for new customers but no loyalty discount.   It would be good to get some pricing relief for longterm customers

reviews.title: Xero = pain
reviews.text: In 2026, most software is really well designed. It's intuitive, it helps the user get done what they need, and it's generally fairly frictionless. Xero is literally the opposite of that. Anything you want to do requires a search on Google, a link to a broken webpage, or a series of instructions that don't make sense without a lot of extra information. The idea that Xero supports small businesses is preposterous. I would strongly recommend using wave accounting as an alternative. But I'm stuck with this because all the accountants use it.

reviews.title: Missing funtionality? HIDDEN SUPPORT CONTACT
reviews.text:
HIDDEN SUPPORT option! Why is this more obvious to find?????
Locked out of changing subscription - feels like a SCAM?
Unable to manage Subscription - they even made a screen to talk about this limitation.
Unable to see transaction inside contact details. Restricted date ranges on searching for transactions. This seems like a very cut down, dumbed down version of the browser based Xero?

Apparently 100’s of 1 and 2 star reviews like make this a dangerous app to pin your finances on - maybe stick to the website or avoid using Xero?

reviews.title: Not happy
reviews.text: Just downloaded the app and paid for the subscription only for the app to crash and is forcing me behind another paywall without allowing me to access even though I have a subscription

reviews.title: App just crashes
reviews.text: I download the app chose my plan paid for subscription and then it just freezes never had chance to add business details in feels like a con

reviews.title: No good
reviews.text: Doesn’t really have anything on it

reviews.title: Annoying ‘how to’ appearing
reviews.text: Have been using the app for years but now I keep getting a ‘how to’ tutorial prompt when I go to create an invoice. I know how to, I don’t need to watch a tutorial multiple times! Should be an option to not show message again.

reviews.title: Worse app I ever use!!
reviews.text: The app is slow, and it often fails to upload. Consequently, I have to manually create an invoice for each customer. Additionally, the inventory is inaccurate because the product count after sales is incorrect. This issue even affects the BAS report, causing me to pay more tax than I should.

reviews.title: Impossible to send an invoice
reviews.text: I keep getting an error that says can’t display invoice on mobile log into xero.com to access invoices. I’ve tried updating the app, uninstalling and reinstalling and nothing is working

reviews.title: No customer support
reviews.text: They are charging me monthly yet there's no way to login and the authenticator app doesn't work. I tried to use Google authenticator and that doesn't work. Why am I paying for a subscription that I can't even log into and no way to cancel and no customer support. How do you get customer support when you can't login and you have to login to access it

reviews.title: ND Sparrow Earthworks
reviews.text: I haven’t been able to send a quote today, I have tried multiple times and now I have missed out on the job , it was a time critical situation… $4800+Gst

reviews.title: Billed twice, doesn’t load
reviews.text:
I’ve deleted and loaded this app twice, it’s billed me twice and still freezes. No solutions, or ability to choose options for a different plan either. 

Fix your app and forced billing, may as well go back to QB at this rate.

reviews.title: Good enough app. Overpriced
reviews.text: I only use this because my accountant insisted. It’s good, but costs me £50 a month for each of my businesses. Absolute rip off really.
